channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit and more, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Room AI: Redesign Your Room by Talking to It Like a Designer
item.description: Talk to it like a designer and change your room one step at a time, seeing the result as you go.

item.title: Enrichable – open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment
item.description: Describe the list of companies or people you need and it fills the sheet, then add columns in plain English and let AI research every row on the live web, with sources for each answer.

item.title: Orthosetter: A Deterministic Typesetting Tool for Orthodox Music
item.description: A typesetting tool built for Orthodox church music that turns your scores into consistently formatted sheet music pages.

item.title: Archiver: Free In-Browser Tool to Extract and Create ZIP, 7z and RAR Archives
item.description: Extract and create ZIP, 7z, RAR and more right in your browser — files never leave your device, with encryption and repair for damaged archives.

item.title: Oh So Video
item.description: Free in-browser video tools to compress, trim, caption, convert, and mute.

item.title: Rezora IO: Launch an AI Voice Agent in 10 Minutes
item.description: Build an AI voice agent the way you'd set up a Shopify store — live and answering calls in ten minutes.

item.title: Nuko: Motion Design in Your Browser
item.description: Design motion graphics right in the browser — no install needed, just open it and start animating on the timeline.

item.title: Adside: A Team of AI Agents That Manage Your Paid Ads
item.description: A team of specialized AI agents manages your paid ads for you, from launch to optimization, without you watching over them.

item.title: What is localhost? An Interactive Guide
item.description: An interactive guide that explains what localhost is — click through the demos and see how local services actually work.

item.title: RoomDesign Genius
item.description: Upload a photo of your room and get four AI redesigns in your chosen style, plus free in-browser floor plan tools.

item.title: Show HN: Can an AI Agent Bypass Your Website Security?
item.description: Point it at your site and a frontier AI agent tries to break in, then shows you what it managed to do and how risky that is.

item.title: Show HN: Klistra – A complete studio for spec-driven AI motion design and video
item.description: Describe what you want and upload your files, and it designs and animates every scene to your brand — change one detail and only that detail changes, with identical re-renders.

item.title: Vibes Matrix: Simplify Complex Life Decisions
item.description: Turns a tangled life decision into a clear comparison — free, no sign-up, right in the browser.

item.title: AI Image Extender
item.description: Extend photos with AI to any aspect ratio, filling in the scene without cropping the subject.

item.title: I Love the Smiths AI
item.description: Put yourself in the famous elevator scene from (500) Days of Summer and generate your own version.

item.title: Sheru Bhai AI Video Generator
item.description: Upload one or two portraits and generate a 10-second Sheru Bhai-style video.

item.title: Lewis Structure Generator
item.description: A free Lewis dot structure calculator that draws electron-dot diagrams for your molecule.

item.title: PsychologyTests
item.description: Take short psychology questionnaires scored privately right in your browser.

item.title: Spanish Word Unscrambler & Word Finder
item.description: Enter jumbled letters and find the Spanish words they can spell.

item.title: KlingVideo
item.description: A free Kling AI video generator that turns text or images into cinematic clips.
